title: Figure 12: Schematic of Earth-to-Mars real-time control of a rover via entangled photons
description: Color schematic showing a green arc labeled "Earth" with a red "Control Station" and an orange arc labeled "Mars" with a blue "Base Station" connected by a "Local Com Link" to a "Mars Rover." Two dashed lines between the planets are labeled "Video and Data from Rover" and "Entangled Photons for Real-Time Control." The caption reads "Figure 12. Schematic of Earth-to-Mars Real-Time Control of a Rover."
